display.purpose: Chakra Petch — engraved device labels, wordmark, headings.

body.purpose: Chakra Petch — incidental captions and field labels.

readout.purpose: Share Tech Mono — numeric measurement values on readout cells only.

shadows.name: raised-metal
shadows.purpose: Raised faces, bezel rims, bolted panel relief.

shadows.name: recessed-display
shadows.purpose: LCD window and numeric readout cells.

shadows.name: amber-led-glow
shadows.purpose: Active readout numerals and the live LED only.

components.name: Bolted Panel
components.description: Engraved aluminum sub-plate bolted to the chassis; holds a zone of controls.
components.css: .fp-panel { background: var(--alu); border: 1px solid var(--chassis-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: var(--raised-metal); padding: 12px 16px; }

components.name: LED Readout Input
components.description: Dark inset cell with an amber tabular numeral; the control reads like a digital readout.
components.css: .fp-readout { background: var(--display-bezel); color: var(--amber); font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: var(--recessed-display); }

components.name: Chrome Toggle
components.description: Snap-action switch for boolean options (alternate colors, two-color ruler).

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Big chrome pushbutton — the save/record control beneath the display.
components.css: .fp-action { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--chrome-light), var(--chrome-dark)); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: var(--raised-metal); }

components.name: Meter Readout Chip
components.description: Dark inset chip in the display bar showing the live cell count; amber pops in both themes because it sits on display-bezel, never on the light bar.
components.css: .fp-meter-readout { background: var(--display-bezel); color: var(--amber); font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: var(--recessed-display); text-shadow: var(--amber-led-glow); }

narrative.overview: Piastra Print is dressed as one cassette-era instrument fascia: a beige chassis holding an aluminum control deck and a backlit LCD. Amber LEDs are the only signal, chrome switches the only controls, engraved caps the only labels. The product's own geometry reads as the instrument's native scale, so what you tune and what you print share one grammar. Density and legibility outrank expression; personality lives in material fidelity — brushed grain, inset bezels, amber that glows only where a reading happens. Light/dark is the same device under two room lights, not light-app/dark-app.
keyCharacteristics: Brushed-aluminum ground framed by beige chassis
Single amber signal reserved for measurement and live state
Chrome tactile controls; engraved uppercase labels
Squared bolted panels with near-zero radius
One device, two room-lights (lit bench / dim studio)

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only saturated color — readouts, live indicator, active state, focus — under 10% of any viewport.

rules.name: The Measurement-Only Rule
rules.body: Share Tech Mono is used only for numeric measurement values and counts; labels and headings use Chakra Petch.

dos: Do render metal with real relief (highlight + shade + offset shadow) and brushed grain via CSS gradients.
Do spend amber only on readouts, the live indicator, the active state, and focus.
Do make light/dark the same device under two room lights.
donts: Don't use flat gray for secondary text — tint it warm.
Don't put mono on labels or headings — measurement only.
Don't use large radii, pill cards, nested cards, or illustrated skeuomorphic props.
